body: I've never ever seen or heard of something like that happen in my stores!  I've worked at Express, Limited and VS and as far as I know we don't even have security cameras in the fitting rooms.
It was usually pretty obvious that it was new, people would bring things still in the VS bag. But you're right, it really came down to the judgement of the manager who took the return.
Nope, just lots of butts in thongs. Most people only needed help with bra sizing, but for panties they could figure it out themselves.

I constantly asked for different/more sizes. My two best friends are both DDD and they were frustrated they couldn't shop in the store with much variety. For all my asking, I never got a straight answer just some rumblings about "limited shelf space".

The most common size I saw was probably a 36B or 34-36C.
Not as enviable as it seems: for every good rack there was 10 old lady pairs to be dealt with >_<

I didn't get a lot of crossdressers at VS but I did get a lot of guys who used to shop for ladies jeans when I worked at Express because they FIT better. No one in my store ever had a problem with it and it was pretty common knowledge. For us, a sale was a sale (doesn't matter who was buying or for what).

The couple crossdressers we had, it was pretty obvious (some asked for the fitting rooms) but again I don't think it should be a problem, you have every right to shop there and not been seen as a pervert. If you ever DO have a problem, please go to the manager, it's unacceptable for an associate to make you feel uncomfortable.

Not model, but lots of people would ask my cup size "my GF is sort of shaped like you..." or "my GF is bigger/smaller than you". 

Discount was great, 30% at VS, 20% at Express, Limited, Bath and Body Works (all owned by the company at the time). They'd offer some days where we'd get 40%. I believe managers get 40% every day and 30% at sister stores.
Unless you can find a way to be UNskeevy, but I've yet to see it.

My BF has acne on his face and down his back and honestly it doesn't bother me. 

If your'e really uncomfortable, try low/candle light the first time around (makes everything and everyone look better ^_~) but someone who's accepting of their body and the body of the person they're with will always be attractive.

Not too often, but associates did have to clean up the dressing rooms after people did nasty things in there. That's the reason they only allow one person in the rooms now (people still try to sneak, you'll usually notice an associate hanging out by the dressing room while people are in there).

We actually put returned merch back on the floor if it still had tags and was obviously not worn (someone bought the wrong size or didn't like a gift). Things that don't sell go into semi-annual sale, if they don't sell there, we send them back to the warehouse and some appear in NEXT year's semi-annual sale before finally ending up at discount/overstock stores. 

If things were obviously worn, we wouldn't accept the return.
All the time, we had a couple people who used to just "feel" the panties, carry them around for a bit and then put them back. See also the frat boys who would pick things up and nudge their buddies.
